_doc: SDG goal -> our axes. HUMAN-OWNED, and a ROUTING HINT ONLY.
READ THIS BEFORE USING IT AS A FILTER. core/source_registration.py refuses, in
writing, to add an axis-fit filter to intake, and for a reason that applies here too:
cross-domain evidence is the point. Child mortality is evidence about governance
capacity; grid frequency is evidence about both infrastructure and economy. A map
like this one, used to DECIDE what an axis may see, would mechanically destroy
exactly the cross-domain feeds the system exists to combine — and it would do it
So this map only ORDERS a catalog for a human who asked about one axis. Nothing is
removed: provider_catalog always reports how many series it set aside, and --all
shows every one of them. A series this map does not associate with an axis can still
be ingested for that axis, by hand, with no override and no warning — because the map
being silent about a pairing is not evidence that the pairing is wrong.
Several goals map to several axes on purpose. A goal is not an axis and pretending
the two are in bijection would be the same tidiness error in a different place.
_axes_with_no_sdg_goal: -- these are not gaps in the map. The SDGs are a 2030 human-development agenda and
have nothing to say about deep time, space, or this system's own progress. Recording
the silence is better than inventing a mapping to make the table look complete.
